name: all-pakistan-cities-list
description: Comprehensive, corrected list of 279 Pakistani cities by province — Punjab, Sindh, KPK (incl. former FATA), Balochistan, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan, and Islamabad. Includes JSON data, helper functions, and an HTML dropdown.

scripts.test: node -e "const c=require('./index.js'); console.assert(c.getAllCities().length===c.raw.total_cities, 'city count mismatch'); console.log('OK:', c.raw.total_cities, 'cities');"
